content.title: Recommendations (excerpt)

Aortic stenosis.recommendation: Aortic valve intervention, TAVI or SAVR, is recommended in patients with HF and severe high‑gradient aortic stenosis to reduce mortality and improve symptoms.
Aortic stenosis.notes: Reference note 594 on image; emphasizes intervention in HF patients with severe high‑gradient AS.

Aortic stenosis.recommendation: Choice between TAVI and SAVR should be made by the Heart Team according to individual patient preference and features including age, surgical risk, clinical, anatomical and procedural aspects, weighing risks and benefits of each approach.
Aortic stenosis.notes: Reference note 592 on image; shared decision by Heart Team.

Secondary mitral regurgitation.recommendation: Percutaneous edge‑to‑edge mitral valve repair should be considered in carefully selected patients with secondary mitral regurgitation, not eligible for surgery and not needing coronary revascularization, who are symptomatic despite OMT and who fulfil criteria for achieving a reduction in HF hospitalizations.
Secondary mitral regurgitation.notes: Reference note 612 on image; candidate selection includes symptomatic despite optimal medical therapy and not surgical candidates.

Secondary mitral regurgitation.recommendation: In patients with HF, severe secondary mitral regurgitation and CAD who need revascularization, CABG and mitral valve surgery should be considered.
Secondary mitral regurgitation.notes: Surgical approach recommended when concurrent CAD requires revascularization.

Secondary mitral regurgitation.recommendation: Percutaneous edge‑to‑edge mitral valve repair may be considered to improve symptoms in carefully selected patients with secondary mitral regurgitation, not eligible for surgery and not needing coronary revascularization, highly symptomatic despite OMT and who do not fulfil criteria for reducing HF hospitalization.
Secondary mitral regurgitation.notes: Reference note 617 on image; weaker recommendation for symptom improvement when hospitalization reduction criteria not met.
